summary: Phase 81.77 Submission Download APIs - All features verified. Backend endpoints working correctly (list documents, download single, download combined). Frontend UI shows new View + Download buttons in Submissions table, and SubmissionDocumentsModal opens with per-document View/Download actions and Download Combined PDF button.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ package_routes.py: _load_submission helper validates run belongs to package/tenant before loading submission
✅ package_routes.py: _refresh_signed_doc_urls regenerates presigned S3 URLs to prevent expiration
✅ package_routes.py: list_submission_documents returns documents with fresh presigned URLs
✅ package_routes.py: download_submission_document fetches from S3 or falls back to presigned URL
✅ package_routes.py: download_submission_combined uses PyPDF2 PdfMerger to combine all signed docs
✅ docflowService.js: listSubmissionDocuments, downloadSubmissionDocument, downloadSubmissionCombined methods added
✅ RunDetailPage.js: Submissions table updated with View + Download buttons per row
✅ RunDetailPage.js: handleSubmissionCombinedDownload triggers combined PDF download
✅ SubmissionDocumentsModal.js: New modal component with per-document View/Download and Download Combined PDF
✅ All endpoints require JWT auth (403 without token)
✅ All endpoints return 404 for invalid submission/run/package IDs

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 81.77 submission download feature fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/docflow/packages/{pkg}/runs/{run}/submissions/{sub}/documents (list docs), GET .../documents/{doc}/download (single PDF), GET .../download/combined (merged PDF). Frontend: Submissions tab in RunDetailPage shows View + Download buttons. View opens SubmissionDocumentsModal with per-document actions and Download Combined PDF button. Test data: v2 test package (70f522d3-7bfb-4889-a144-d7234b22f619) has run with 5 submissions.
